title: Bottomless Trap Hole LOD-092 Legacy of Darkness 1st Edition
categoryName: Toys & Hobbies:Collectible Card Games:CCG Individual Cards
descriptionText:
This rare and highly sought-after Bottomless Trap Hole card from the Yu-Gi-Oh! TCG is a must-have addition to any collector's set. With its English language and 1st Edition features, this card is a true gem for fans of the game. The card number is LOD-092 and it is a Trap-Normal type, making it an ideal addition to any deck.

The card's attributes include a Color of Trap and a Rarity of Rare, while the Game is Yu-Gi-Oh! TCG and the Set is Legacy of Darkness. The manufacturer is Konami, and the card features a unique design that is sure to impress any collector. Don't miss out on the chance to add this amazing card to your collection today!
